title: HLA Typing from scRNA-seq Data
subtitle: Comparison and Optimization of HLA Genotyping Algorithms
description: Built a reproducible pipeline for evaluating HLA genotyping tools on single-cell RNA-seq data, focusing on tool execution, benchmarking, coverage analysis, and failure case interpretation.
highlights: Compared arcasHLA, HLAminer, and OptiType on scRNA-seq data.
Automated evaluation for locus-level accuracy, read count, depth, and coverage.
Analyzed failure cases caused by sparse or unbalanced support at key variant sites.

title: Distributed Embedded Robotic System
subtitle: Mechatronics and System Design
description: Designed a distributed robotic system that separates high-level processing from real-time motor control, integrating web-based communication, video streaming, and sensor-based navigation.
highlights: Designed a distributed control architecture separating high-level processing and real-time motor control.
Integrated an HTTP interface with a custom serial communication protocol.
Implemented real-time MJPEG video streaming and PID-based wall-following control with sensor filtering.
